claims.quote: Selfhosted URL Shortener
claims.statement: The target contains the code needed to create and manage short links on infrastructure the operator controls.

locations.quote: provides the core tools needed to create and manage short links on your own infrastructure

claims.quote: written in Rust
claims.statement: The target's implementation language is Rust.

same_as.statement: The product is a Rust rewrite of the simply-shorten project — a provenance and implementation-language claim

claims.quote: written in Rust
claims.statement: Restatement of claim 3: the implementation language is Rust.

same_as.statement: The product is a Rust rewrite of the simply-shorten project — a provenance and implementation-language claim

claims.quote: using Actix Web as the backend
claims.statement: The backend web framework is Actix Web.

same_as.statement: The backend is written in Rust using the Actix Web framework.

claims.quote: The frontend is written in html, css, and vanilla javascript
claims.statement: The frontend is implemented in HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with no frontend framework.

same_as.statement: The frontend is written in plain HTML and vanilla JS, styled with Pure CSS.

claims.quote: Links are stored in an SQLite database
claims.statement: The data store for links is SQLite.

same_as.statement: Links are stored in an SQLite database.

claims.quote: distributed in a tiny container image (<4.5 MB for the scratch image and <8.5 MB for the alpine image, both compressed)
claims.statement: The distributed container image is smaller than 4.5 MB compressed (scratch variant) and smaller than 8.5 MB compressed (alpine variant). A quantity claim naming two image variants.

claims.quote: uses <10 MB of RAM under regular load
claims.statement: The service uses less than 10 MB of RAM under regular load.

same_as.statement: The service runs in under 10 MB of RAM in ordinary operation

claims.quote: It’s free and open source, released under the MIT license
claims.statement: The software is free and open source, released under the MIT licence.

claims.quote: maintained by SinTan1729
claims.statement: The project is maintained by SinTan1729.

same_as.statement: The project is maintained by SinTan1729.

claims.quote: No tracking.
claims.statement: Claim of absence: the target performs no tracking of users.

same_as.statement: Under the heading 'Bloat that will not be implemented', the target performs no tracking or spying of any kind.

claims.quote: Create short URLs with generated slugs or custom aliases.
claims.statement: The target supports creating short URLs both with auto-generated slugs and with custom aliases.

claims.quote: Set short links to expire automatically after a chosen duration.
claims.statement: The target contains code by which an operator can give a short link a duration after which it is set to expire.

same_as.statement: The tool contains expiry logic that deactivates or removes links after a user-chosen time.

claims.quote: Track how many times a short link has been used.
claims.statement: The target contains code that maintains a per-link hit count.

same_as.statement: The tool contains hit-counting code that keeps a per-link visit count.

claims.quote: Update existing links and manage their metadata.
claims.statement: The target supports editing existing links and managing their metadata.

claims.quote: Attach notes to links and filter them in the web UI.
claims.statement: The target supports attaching notes to links and filtering links by note in the web UI.

claims.quote: Generate QR codes and integrate with the service programmatically.
claims.statement: The target supports generating QR codes for short links and exposes a programmatic API.

locations.quote: Use the web interface to create, edit, and manage short URLs on your own instance.

claims.quote: Snappy WebUI
claims.statement: The target has a web UI (asserted by the Screenshots section heading; 'Snappy' is puffery and is not part of the claim).

claims.quote: Run Chhoto URL with Docker, Podman, or another OCI-compatible container workflow.
claims.statement: The target is deployable as an OCI-compatible container, e.g. with Docker or Podman.

claims.quote: Set the required environment variables for the site URL, credentials, and storage configuration.
claims.statement: The target is configured through environment variables covering the site URL, credentials and storage.

claims.quote: Selfhosted URL Shortener
claims.statement: When the target runs, short links created on it actually work in operation: a visitor who follows a created short link is sent to its destination.

same_as.statement: Opening a short URL in a browser sends the visitor directly to the correct long URL, with no intermediate redirection page.

claims.quote: Set short links to expire automatically after a chosen duration.
claims.statement: When the target runs, a short link with an expiry duration set actually stops working after that duration passes, without anyone intervening manually.

same_as.statement: Links stop working automatically once the chosen time has passed, without any manual action.

claims.quote: Track how many times a short link has been used.
claims.statement: When the target runs, each actual use of a short link is reflected in that link's hit count.

same_as.statement: Each visit to a short link is counted, so the recorded hit count reflects the link's actual traffic.
